objective: Implement simulator-plan.md in full, including Stage 7

requirements: Stable saved identities for inventory, shipments, work, batches and connections; cancelled identities are not reused.
One game clock and complete resident time accounts.
Read-only diagnostics, exact continuation, seeded repeatability and atomic malformed-save rejection.
Compact, dispersed, empty-fund, blocked-access and established protected baselines.
reviewNotes: simulation::allocate monotonically allocates saved identities; public cancellation and exact-checkpoint cases verify they are not reused.
The simulation time report accounts for every resident minute. The clock comparison replays 5,120 identical native steps through normal and selected 16x browser batches with exact complete snapshots.
Inspection, forecasts and native reports preserve the current snapshot. Invalid schema, accounts and references fail atomically; the same seed and checkpoints reproduce the same state.
verify-simulation writes and advances all five protected baselines; compact and dispersed baselines have identical property and seed.

requirements: Arrival, extraction, warehouse, worksite and project stores own their actual goods; summaries distinguish available, reserved, committed and travelling supplies.
Residents collect and deliver along clear paths, with bounded cargo, reserved receiving room and attendance before construction.
Near storage and useful roads reduce actual completion time; priorities and recent workload govern competing jobs.
Interruptions, blocked paths, full stores, cancellation, salvage, warehouse closure and relocation preserve ownership and capacity.
reviewNotes: Located stores own stock; incoming orders, reservations, committed process inputs and cargo are reported separately. Material accounts are checked during real construction and production.
The logistics replay observes actual pickup and delivery before construction; navigation and work-route replays cover occupied foundations, the river, roads and receiving-room reservations.

The logistics comparison completes nearby and paved projects sooner than the same distant unpaved project. Workforce cases change real site selection through priority, preference and recent chore history.

Building-work, logistics, request and native lifecycle cases interrupt actual cargo and cover cancel, salvage, warehouse evacuation and relocation. The pickup correction additionally makes immediate saves valid before another tick.

requirements: Travel, outside shifts, village work, meals, sleep and leisure use the same clock.
Shared reachable jobs respect needs, preferences, workload, agreements, useful working time and limited work positions.
Helping requests visibly accept, travel, wait, work, pause, finish or cancel without duplicate inputs or labour.
Conditional project and fund forecasts use the real simulation and invalidate when player plans change.
Hunger interrupts work, existing crops and overdue animals receive care, and balanced villages preserve individual sleep and substantial leisure.
reviewNotes: Time categories follow actual activity and distinguish sleep from commuting. Outside-job and sleep-speed replays verify travel, attendance, once-only pay, individual sleep and acceleration boundaries.
The shared offer list uses reachable routes, available work positions, preparation, break budgets, personal preferences and recent chores. Agreement and claim cases exercise the competing choices.

The request replay and manual review observe acceptance, a named target, travel, pause reasons, completed work and return to independent activity; completed and cancelled batches preserve exact ownership.
The forecast replays the real simulation without changing it. A matched-horizon outside-shift comparison changes both completion and income; plan changes invalidate stale workers.

The mixed-needs scene chooses rest, a meal, company, dry-crop care and an outside shift for five different residents. Its four-day project and request finish. The seasonal run retains healthy needs and majority individual waking village leisure.

requirements: Located saved batches use delivered inputs, labour, passive duration, targets and bounded output space.
Local camp/workshop manufacture and purchasing both support an actual housing expansion.
Kitchen pots, tools and shared meals use the same located ownership and real attendance.
Food dates survive carriage, refunds and cancellations; expiry is once-only and recovery remains possible.
Growth, digestion, filtration, banana treatment and curing progress independently when their conditions permit; interruptions preserve ownership.
reviewNotes: Production replay observes located input cargo, a single claimed work position, partial attended labour and local output; batch identities and needs interruptions continue exactly.
Five copies of one earned village include purchased roofing and six locally produced roof tiles for an actual adobe home, with housing spending recorded separately from wages.
Kitchen, tools and gathering replays collect actual ingredients and tools, use located pots and tables, and require attendance before useful outputs.
Freshness and food cases carry dated lots, put interrupted food down, return only unexpired inputs and expire lots once. The fresh Story and seasonal runs exercise ongoing pantry recovery.
Passive-process and organics cases retain owned inputs and output room through pause, movement and cancellation; detached digestate continues curing and plant growth follows its actual conditions.

requirements: Seeded fertility, retention, moisture, nutrients, shade, vegetation and finite local deposits persist.
Player-placed extraction depletes its own deposit; planted timber and bamboo grow and can be harvested and replanted.
Suitability changes real growth and yield; construction, roads, extraction and canopy have lasting local effects.
Delivered compost and attended restoration recover soil; depleted deposits and poor layouts retain practical recovery routes.
Grid overlays and placement previews explain the land before commitment without changing the world.
reviewNotes: Land inspection returns seeded soil and nine finite local deposits. Malformed coverage and deposit references are rejected; observed soil and vegetation survive exact checkpoints.

Actual resident extraction exhausts one stone patch without changing a different patch; clearing and replacing its site cannot refill it. Planted timber and bamboo use renewable growth and harvest lifecycles.
Matched gardening cases show slower maturity and smaller yields on depleted ground. Roads and extraction leave persistent disturbance; real standing canopy changes solar exposure and preview values.

Restoration requires reserved compost, physical delivery and attended gradual soil work. The land replay recovers extraction from another patch, and the housing comparison actually moves a poor layout and restores services. restore_source only queues renewable-plot soil work and cannot refill finite deposits.
The same native footprint inspection supplies land overlays and placement information; report and preview calls leave exact snapshots unchanged.

requirements: Fresh water, greywater, sealed sewage and reclaimed irrigation have separate located contents, compatible ports and owned process inputs.
Residents carry bounded, class-appropriate loads along actual routes; manual treated-water and sealed-service alternatives prevent dead ends.
Paid kits, local delivery and resident corridor work precede commissioned flow; priorities, capacity, pausing, dismantling and replacement preserve equipment and contents.
Connected circuits own generation, stored charge, consumption, curtailment and discharge; unconnected consumers cannot use distant supply and rooftop storage stays private.
Pumps need their actual cable connection; optional powered workshop work pauses safely on outage while manual starter work remains available.
Recovered batteries have visible locations, occupied plots, resident transport, safe interruption, charged ownership and once-only material salvage.
reviewNotes: Water and sanitation replays check all four independent liquid accounts, local inputs, sealed committed contents, compatible destinations and returned batch space.

Actual closed-container and fresh-water trips reserve room and walk clear routes. Neighbouring treated-water collection and sealed off-site handoff remain available without granting local treatment outputs.
Pipe and route replays purchase kits, haul them and perform resident installation before flow. Pause, priority, removal, replacement and endpoint movement preserve property and liquids.

Electrical cases compare isolated and connected circuits, local capacity, unequal charge, cable limits and private roofs. Generated, consumed, stored, curtailed and deliberately discharged energy balance separately.

The paid utility comparison installs five liquid lines and pump cables plus workshop power, then operates manual and connected copies for 24 days each. Power-loss cases preserve batches and retain manual starter work.

Battery replay observes a named resident carrying recovered equipment to reserved ground, exact continuation and once-only material salvage with recorded discharge. Native cases cover need interruption and safe pickup refusal during battery transport.

requirements: Saved seeded wet/dry conditions and forecasts consistently affect roots, rain capture, solar output and river generation.
Use and exposure wear owned equipment; warnings, spare parts, delivered kits and attended service allow recovery from failure.
Bounded useful practice grants gradual skills, including paid occupations, while novices retain ordinary work.
Supplier prices, finite offers and freight changes are predictable; confirmed receipts remain firm and essential goods remain available.
The completed village operates across repeated seasons with paid maintenance, healthy reserves, exact saves, valid accounts and majority waking village leisure.
reviewNotes: Climate and weather cases preserve the seeded future and compare actual crop water, collection, solar and river effects; the extended village observes both seasons and real rain.

Maintenance replay purchases parts through a real resident pickup, observes kit cargo and attended repair, pauses and resumes a service, and restores the same owned equipment without changing charge ownership.
Six domains gain bounded daily practice from completed useful work and an actual paid outside shift; pausing learning preserves experience and ordinary jobs remain available to novices.
Supplier replay reserves finite offers, rejects stale quotes, refunds once, restocks on schedule and preserves confirmed price and arrival terms across subsequent option and calendar changes.

The earned optional campaign operates for another 84 days with 85 exact checkpoints, seven completed service jobs with paid parts, 8–61 directly edible portions, healthy needs and at least 68% waking village leisure per resident.

requirements: Thirteen linear chapters teach all six systems through meaningful outcomes; earlier valid work counts and all twenty-one buildings have actionable introductions.
Primary goals are separate from 47 optional measurable lessons and seven reference guides; every building is not required for campaign completion.

Saved observation windows use reachable, unclaimed edible food, actual needs, household services, powered nights, leisure and dry-period comfort; spending and delivery challenges use actual transactions.
Both fresh minimal and complete optional campaigns finish through player commands, paid supplies, resident work, care and gatherings, with exact chapter checkpoints.
Five independent copies of one earned one-home village compare layout, method, outside work and preferences; each supports occupied housing, paid services, dry-weather operation and leisure.
A poorly placed home recovers through actual resident relocation and restored metered services.
First-fifteen-minute and first-week pacing are recorded; these are 1x clock equivalents, excluding reading time and automatic acceleration.
Sandbox retains free placement and comfortable defaults, with independently saved construction/supply, living-land and utility constraints; rules preserve existing property and orders.
Desktop controls, day/night artwork, cargo, overlays, blocked-work feedback, read-only panels and protected-save isolation pass rendered review.
Formatting, all native tests, strict all-target lint, WebAssembly, script syntax and every public verifier pass on the final engine.
reviewNotes: The objective catalog covers thirteen chapters and all twenty-one building types; fresh minimal and full optional play use the real linear unlocks, construction, purchases, resident work and gatherings.

The minimal route completes without nine optional building types. The complete route earns all 47 measurable lessons; seven guide entries do not add campaign gates. Desktop checks keep optional paths separate from primary progress.

Native outcome tests distinguish claimed, expiring, committed and inaccessible food; require actual needs and local services; retain consecutive observation windows; and count only completed short deliveries and net paid housing purchases.
Fresh campaigns complete on day 38 and day 92, respectively, with exact chapter saves. The optional run builds all twenty-one types without authored inventory, money, clock or progress.

Five independent earned one-home copies support real occupied housing, paid installation, at least fourteen operating days including seven dry days, healthy needs, majority leisure and 249 exact checkpoints.
The distant-home case performs resident relocation and replacement installation; metered fresh and greywater flow resumes through new active lines.

The pacing report records fifteen minutes at the 1x game-clock rate and the first week: well complete and home half built at the first sample; the introductory chapter and core food buildings complete by the week sample. Scripted choices are serial and exclude reading and automatic acceleration.

All eight combinations of independently saved Sandbox rules are replayed. Comfortable defaults and free placement remain; switching constraints preserves confirmed orders, property and paused projects.

The desktop suite exercises controls, overlays, blocked work, protected saves and artwork tools. Manual review separately checks resident decisions, request follow-through, the journal, day/night proportions and the real full-canvas PNG export.

The final release report must contain passing formatting, all 507 native tests, strict all-target lint, the matching WebAssembly build, every script syntax check, all public verifiers and the complete desktop suite. Hosted CI status is recorded separately.
